svg.title: Plate PL-06 — The sperm: physics dictates form at Re much less than 1
svg.desc: An engraved-style encyclopedia plate in six panels. Panel I computes the Reynolds number on the plate from four sourced inputs and gets 4.9 times ten to the minus three, then computes the Stokes coasting distance, 0.45 angstrom, drawn to scale against the 1.54 angstrom carbon-carbon bond: inertia is absent. Panel II draws the nine-plus-two axoneme in cross-section with no dimension at all, because the source chapter carries none; two of the nine doublets are shaded as the hypothesized active fraction, and the Summers and Gibbons trypsin ablation is recorded with its attribution correction. Panel III draws Purcell’s scallop theorem as the refuted alternative: a reciprocal paddle whose net displacement is exactly zero, with the reason drawn in configuration space, one degree of freedom enclosing no area; the drag anisotropy that all flagellar thrust is bought from is printed with a plate note where the chapter’s stated range and its own formula do not reproduce one another. Panel IV draws the flagellar travelling wave to scale in wavelength and length at two viscosities, showing the frequency halving from 23 to 11 hertz while the swimming speed does not change. Panel V draws the helical swim to scale as a sampling instrument that converts a static spatial gradient into a periodic temporal signal, and prices the detour at 33 percent of path length. Panel VI carries the figure key, the caption and what the plate does not claim. Every number carries units, a ledger row and an evidence class. The plate contains zero UNI claims.
svg.text: UNI ENCYCLOPEDIA & COOKBOOK · NATURA WING
PLATE PL-06
THE SPERM — PHYSICS DICTATES FORM AT Re ≪ 1
Source chapter: CN-06 (cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-06-sperm.md) · rows CN06-01…CN06-39 of encyclopedia/NATURE-LEDGER.md · corpus tip f1be794
~2 of 11+ developmental rungs earned
ZERO UNI CLAIMS ON THIS PLATE
A nature citation is never a UNI gate.
I
THE REGIME — compute it before you draw anything
HUMAN
Re = ρuL/µ — put real numbers in. Nothing here is asserted; it is arithmetic,
and every input was re-evaluated for this plate from its own ledger row.
ρ = 1.0 × 10³ kg/m³ water. 993 at 37 °C — a 0.7 %
correction cannot move an exponent.
migrating human sperm, 37 °C, n = 16
WHO 2021 normative criteria — NOT a
measured distribution. See caption 2.
aqueous buffer, 37 °C
△ MODELED · CN06-10
bracket 2 – 6 × 10⁻³ over u = 30–65 µm/s, L = 50–60 µm
In cervical mucus, µ ≈ 0.14 Pa·s: Re ≈ 2.6 × 10⁻⁵ △ CN06-11
That row uses u = 65 µm/s (the high-viscosity migrant velocity),
NOT the 62 µm/s above. At u = 62 it is 2.4 × 10⁻⁵. The input swap is
named because the exponent does not care but the scope must not lie.
NOW THE CONSEQUENCE — computed, not asserted
If the flagellum stopped, how far would the cell coast?
τ = m/(6πµa) V ≈ 17 µm³, ρ_cell ≈ 1.1×10³ kg/m³, a ≈ 2 µm
6πµa = 2.6 × 10⁻⁸ kg/s m ≈ 1.9 × 10⁻¹⁴ kg
DRAWN TO SCALE — the coast against a carbon–carbon bond
C–C bond 1.54 Å
the coast 0.45 Å — 29 % of one bond
INERTIA IS NOT “SMALL” HERE. IT IS ABSENT.
Every micron of progress must be paid for at the instant it is made.
This is the requirements document. Read it first or build the wrong thing.
II
THE 9+2 AXONEME — cross-section, ARRANGEMENT ONLY
SEA URCHIN
◇ NOT-SOURCED — this drawing carries NO dimension.
CN-06 states the arrangement (nine doublets around a central pair) and carries no
diameter, no spacing, no doublet size. NOT TO SCALE. A gap in OUR homework, not the literature.
central pair
“the 2”
WHAT IS DRAWN, AND ON WHAT AUTHORITY
· nine doublet microtubules, one central pair — CN-06 §The motor.
· radial spokes and nexin links — drawn because the ablation below
is about them. Their identification is LATER work, not S&G 1971.
· doublet numbering and orientation: drawn for reference only.
CN-06 carries no numbering convention. Not asserted.
▨ 2 of 9 doublets shaded
○ HYPOTHESIZED · CN06-14
67,500 × 2/9 = 15,000 active/beat is an
ARITHMETIC consequence of the two-groups-
of-doublets hypothesis — not an observation.
n_dynein ~67,500 motors total, whole flagellum
— OBSERVED-REPLICATED (cryo-ET)
d_dynein ~8 nm per power stroke — CN06-15
r_ATP (2.4 ± 0.3) × 10⁶ ATP/s active
(9.2 ± 0.2) × 10⁵ ATP/s INACTIVE † CN06-18
dyneins burn ATP even when not swimming.
SLIDING IS NOT BENDING — and the receipt is an ablation
Dynein slides adjacent doublets past each other. Sliding is shear. Shear is not bending.
The conversion is done by CONSTRAINT. Summers & Gibbons (1971), PNAS 68(12):3092–3096:
briefly digest the axoneme with trypsin, then add ATP.
INTACT + ATP
it bends → it swims
TRYPSIN + ATP
it does NOT bend — it DISINTEGRATES ACTIVELY,
sliding apart into tubules, coiling into a helix.
◇ How far it extended is NOT-SOURCED · CN06-16 — “five or more times” is WITHDRAWN as unsourced;
secondary accounts conflict (several-fold / ~7× / nine-fold). Falsifier: read S&G 1971 pp. 3092–3096 and print it.
✗ ATTRIBUTION CORRECTION — SIGNUM SIGNUM MANET. S&G 1971 did NOT identify what trypsin removed.
That the targets are radial-spoke heads and nexin links, dynein arms intact, is LATER work (Witman et al.).
THE LINKS ARE NOT SCAFFOLDING. THE LINKS ARE THE TRANSMISSION.
Remove the thing that resists sliding and the motor still runs, still burns ATP, still generates force —
and the machine disintegrates instead of swimming. Curvature is what shear becomes when you
refuse to let it go anywhere.
III
PURCELL’S SCALLOP THEOREM — the refuted alternative, drawn
Purcell (1977), Am J Phys 45:3–11 — the constraint a naive designer violates:
A BODY AT LOW REYNOLDS NUMBER CANNOT PROPEL ITSELF BY A PURELY RECIPROCAL DEFORMATION.
The Stokes equations contain no time derivative. The flow is set entirely by the INSTANTANEOUS boundary configuration, so net displacement depends only on the
SEQUENCE OF SHAPES, never on the rate they are traversed. Open the scallop slowly, close it quickly — it does not matter. Speed buys nothing.
✗ THE OBVIOUS SOLUTION — REFUTED
One hinge. One degree of freedom. Stroke, then recovery.
open
t0
closing
t1
closed
t2
opening
t3
open
t4
slow
fast
START and END hinge positions are the SAME line.
Δx = 0 EXACTLY. Not inefficient. ZERO.
WHY — drawn in CONFIGURATION SPACE
Net displacement depends on the shape PATH, so ask what the path can enclose.
1 DOF — the paddle
config space is a LINE
θ
out
back — the SAME path
ENCLOSED AREA = 0
→ Δx = 0
(the two arrows are drawn apart
for legibility: it is one line.)
θ₁
θ₂
2 DOF — Purcell’s three-link swimmer
the cycle ENCLOSES AREA
→ Δx ≠ 0
The flagellum takes the same escape: a travelling wave traces a loop that never retraces itself.
AND THE WAVE ALONE IS STILL NOT ENOUGH
Thrust exists only because of DRAG ANISOTROPY on a slender rod.
v
ζ⊥
ζ∥
△ MODELED · CN06-13 · Gray & Hancock 1955
slenderness is the fence
LEDGER VALUE, printed verbatim: ≈2 ASYMPTOTIC ONLY;
~1.5–1.8 at realistic aspect ratios; strictly < 2 for any real filament.
◇ PLATE NOTE — surfaced, not patched. The printed formula at the
printed ln(2λ/a) ≈ 3–5 gives ≈1.43–1.64, not 1.5–1.8; 1.8 needs ln ≈ 9.5.
Both sit inside the row’s OWN falsifier bracket 1.4–2.0. See caption 6.
SET THE RATIO TO 1 AND THE THRUST INTEGRATES TO ZERO —
travelling wave or not. All flagellar propulsion rides on this.
‡ THE FENCE ON THIS PANEL — load-bearing, not a footnote
Cervical mucus is VISCOELASTIC, not Newtonian (µ_mucus ~0.2 Pa·s Day 0 → ~0.68 Pa·s Day 5, Maxwell fit to Wolf et al. 1977 moduli — △ MODELED · CN06-09). So the theorem’s
PREMISE IS VIOLATED IN VIVO. Lauga (2011), Soft Matter 7:3060–3065, lists non-Newtonian fluids as one of the legitimate escapes — alongside inertia, extra degrees of freedom,
hydrodynamic interactions and boundaries. The theorem still explains why the flagellum is a travelling wave. Anyone who says “the scallop theorem forbids X in the female tract” has skipped a step.
THE CHAPTER’S OPERABLE FALSIFIER — this is what would move the whole chapter, not one row:
Exhibit ONE microswimmer achieving sustained net progression in a NEWTONIAN fluid at Re < 10⁻² using a STRICTLY RECIPROCAL shape sequence (one degree of freedom, forward path =
time-reverse of return path), with the medium’s Newtonian rheology measured and reported, and inertial, boundary and hydrodynamic-interaction effects excluded. Non-Newtonian media do
not count — viscoelasticity is already a named escape INSIDE the theory. A refuted row moves that row; a refuted scallop theorem moves the chapter.

✗ Recorded INADMISSIBLE (CN-06): “sperm race to the egg and the fastest wins.” It names no falsifier — “fastest” is unmeasured in vivo and the tract is not a racecourse. The race narrative is a story fitted to the outcome.
IV
THE TRAVELLING WAVE — drawn to scale in λ and L; and the invariance
HUMAN
Scale: 13.5 px per µm. λ and flagellar length are TO SCALE. Amplitude and envelope are ◇ NOT-SOURCED — CN-06 carries no beat amplitude — so the envelope is schematic and asserts nothing.
LOW VISCOSITY — buffer, µ ≈ 0.7 mPa·s, 37 °C
f_beat = 23 Hz — CN06-02 · λ = 39 µm — CN06-04 · one wavelength barely fits the flagellum
λ = 39 µm
wave travels head → tip
HIGH VISCOSITY — ~0.14 Pa·s analogue, SAME CELLS, SAME 37 °C
f_beat = 11 Hz — CN06-02 · λ = 18 µm — CN06-04 · ~2.3 wavelengths on the same flagellum
λ = 18 µm
wave travels head → tip
L_flag = 41 µm — the ONLY MEASURED length (Saggiorato et al. 2017, tethered human cells) — CN06-07
‡ THREE FLAGELLAR LENGTHS IN CN-06 AND THEY DO NOT RECONCILE — carried, not averaged
41 µm MEASURED (Saggiorato 2017 —) · tail ≥45 µm NORMATIVE CRITERIA (WHO 2021 ∅) · 50 µm cylinder in the coasting volume.
The only MEASURED one is the smallest and sits BELOW the criteria floor, implying ~46 µm total, not the 55 µm fed into the headline Re.
If Saggiorato is right the printed Re is ~20 % HIGH. The exponent survives either way — and the exponent is the load-bearing part.
SAME CELLS · SAME 37 °C · ONLY THE FLUID CHANGES
Smith et al. 2009, Cell Motil Cytoskeleton 66(4):220–236
low viscosity
beat frequency
23 Hz
11 Hz
wavelength
39 µm
18 µm
wavespeed
890 µm/s
200 µm/s
progression / beat
2.7 µm
5.8 µm
progressive velocity
62 µm/s
65 µm/s
THE FREQUENCY HALVES. THE WAVESPEED DROPS 4.4-FOLD.
THE SWIMMING SPEED DOES NOT CHANGE.
The cell trades frequency for wavelength along an approximately
constant-wavespeed constraint and holds its output flat against a
~200-fold rise in viscosity.
CHECKED ON THIS PLATE: c = f × λ
Yazdan Parast et al. (2024), Small Methods 8(7):e2300928 report the
same invariance across 75–1,000 mPa·s, with sperm dissipating over
sixfold more energy into the fluid without elevating metabolic
activity. (CN-06 prose; no ledger row in this pass.)
✗ NEGATIVE / conflation trap: quoting a beat frequency without its
viscosity AND temperature. 23 Hz and 11 Hz are the SAME CELLS.
And the kinematics do not explain everything: Smith et al. observed a
34 µm/s spread in progressive velocity among high-viscosity migrants
that their kinematic parameters DID NOT EXPLAIN. Carried, not smoothed.
AND THE EFFICIENCY IS HONESTLY TERRIBLE — which is the instructive part
ε_swim = ε_chemo · ε_hydro — checked on this plate: 0.34 × 0.004 ≈ 0.001 ✓ · 0.6 × 0.013 ≈ 0.008 ✓
The dynein-to-mechanical-work conversion is respectable (34–60 %). The HYDRODYNAMIC efficiency is 0.4–1.3 %.
The authors name the reason: the PREDOMINANT CONTRIBUTION OF ELASTIC DEFORMATION over hydrodynamic dissipation.
Almost all the mechanical work goes into bending the flagellum against its own stiffness; almost none goes into pushing water.
THE AXONEME IS NOT A WELL-DESIGNED PROPELLER. IT IS A WELL-DESIGNED BENDING MACHINE THAT HAPPENS TO PROPEL.
✗ FENCE, load-bearing: these are DEMEMBRANATED SEA-URCHIN axonemes at
[ATP] = 20 µM — NOT intact human sperm at physiological ATP. Quoting them as
human properties drops the species, the membrane, the [ATP] AND the load.
ε_hydro for an intact human spermatozoon is ∅ NOT-MEASURED · CN06-22.
n_ATP/beat is NOT viscosity-independent: (2.3±0.2)×10⁵ → (3.2±0.5)×10⁵ · CN06-17.
V
THE HELICAL SWIM — temporal sampling as EPISTEMIC ACTION
SEA URCHIN
Jikeli et al. (2015), Nat Commun 6:7985 — Arbacia punctulata tracked holographically in 3-D, n = 20, 1 s tracks. — OBSERVED-REPLICATED · CN06-32. Drawn to scale at 6.5 px per µm.
◇ READ THIS BEFORE THE DRAWING: r = 8.4 ± 3.1 µm, period = 0.38 ± 0.07 s, pitch = 47.6 ± 9.1 µm, u = 200 ± 57 µm/s are the UNSTIMULATED BASELINE — free 3-D swimming FAR FROM
BOUNDARIES with NO CHEMOATTRACTANT GRADIENT PRESENT. They are the control the chemotactic responses were later measured against. The gradient drawn below is the ARGUMENT, not the condition.
axis
∇c
low c
pitch = 47.6 ± 9.1 µm = ONE TURN = 0.38 ± 0.07 s
c at the receptor
t
one turn = one full cycle of the stimulus
A STATIC SPATIAL GRADIENT ARRIVES AT THE RECEPTORS AS A PERIODIC TEMPORAL MODULATION.
THE HELIX IS THE SAMPLING INSTRUMENT
The helical motion sweeps the flagellum through the field, so a static
gradient arrives as a periodic modulation, which entrains Ca²⁺
oscillations, which steer. The helix is NOT a side-effect of asymmetric
beating that navigation tolerates. It is the instrument.
THAT IS EPISTEMIC ACTION, AT THE SCALE OF ONE CELL
A policy chosen NOT because it moves toward the goal — a helix is a
DETOUR — but because it RESOLVES UNCERTAINTY about the state.
Goal-only would swim straight and stay blind.
AND THE DETOUR HAS A PRICE — computed on this plate
path per turn = √(pitch² + (2πr)²) = √(47.6² + 52.8²) = 71.1 µm
71.1 µm of PATH buys 47.6 µm of axial PROGRESS → 67.0 %
THE SAMPLING COSTS 33 % OF PATH LENGTH.
△ MODELED — from CN06-32’s four measured parameters; assumes a circular
helix at constant pitch. That assumption is the fence.
AND THE FOUR MEASURED PARAMETERS ARE MUTUALLY CONSISTENT:
71.1 µm / 0.38 s = 187 µm/s of path speed, against a measured
u = 200 ± 57 µm/s. It sits inside the band. Geometry and kinematics
were measured separately and they close. △ computed here.
WHAT THE SENSOR CAN DO — sea urchin, resact
· ONE bound resact molecule evokes a Ca²⁺ response; 50–100 saturate it.
— OBSERVED-REPLICATED · Kaupp et al. 2003 · CN06-28
· minimum detectable gradient 0.8 fM/µm † CN06-29 (single group)
· T_sample 0.2–0.6 s † — a MEASURED Ca²⁺-response LATENCY · CN06-30
· δc/c ∝ (D·a·c·T)^(−1/2) — Berg & Purcell 1977. Precision costs
integration time. — CN06-39
△ Equating that 0.2–0.6 s LATENCY with Berg & Purcell’s integration time T is a
MODELED IDENTIFICATION, not an observation: it assumes the latency is set by
counting statistics rather than transduction kinetics. CN06-30 is a compound row.
✗ DO NOT REPEAT THE FOLK EXPLANATION — ○ HYPOTHESIZED, commonly stated as fact

“A sperm is too small to sense a gradient across its own body, so it samples temporally.” The measurements point ELSEWHERE. Kashikar et al.’s stated mechanism is ELECTROTONIC BLURRING: the CNGK channel is

distributed along the whole flagellum and hyperpolarisation spreads within milliseconds, so spatial information is smeared out. And Tan & Chiam (2018), PLoS Comput Biol 14(3):e1005966, model the choice and conclude
it turns on SPEED-TO-SIZE, NOT SIZE — noting explicitly that sperm are RELATIVELY BIG and use temporal sensing anyway because they are FAST. Three claims, three evidence classes, never merged.
VI
KEY, CAPTION, AND WHAT THIS PLATE DOES NOT CLAIM
FIGURE KEY — marks, not colours (this plate must survive greyscale)
OBSERVED-REPLICATED
measured, and independently replicated across labs, datasets or taxa.
OBSERVED-SINGLE
measured, by a repeatable method, but NO independent replication is on record. One dagger, one study.
OBSERVED-CONTESTED
measured, but the community genuinely disputes it. Both positions carried; the dispute named.
MODELED
derived from a model that fits data. THE ASSUMPTIONS ARE THE FENCE.
HYPOTHESIZED
a stated mechanism with no measurement behind it yet. Never asserted as fact.
NOT-SOURCED
a value this corpus could not trace to a source. A gap in OUR homework, NOT in the literature.
NOT-MEASURED
the honest empty face: nobody has measured it. An absence in the LITERATURE. Never merge with ◇.
NEGATIVE / trap
a conflation or a refuted alternative, recorded first-class — never deleted, never mocked.

Classes are NATURA classes (NA-00, amended 2026-07-15: twelve classes in three groups — measured / derived / fenced). They are SOVEREIGN from the UNI fence (proven · designed · hypothesized · not-yet-built)
and never merge. Line weight, hatch density and dash pattern carry every distinction colour carries.
SPECIES IS A FENCE ON THIS PLATE, NOT A DETAIL
I THE REGIME · IV THE TRAVELLING WAVE → HUMAN
II THE AXONEME · V THE HELIX → SEA URCHIN
CN-06 records quoting II’s or V’s numbers as properties of human sperm as a
conflation trap ✗, first-class. The panels are tagged so the reader cannot
lose the species on the way across the plate.
The corpus also carries what is NOT here: ε_hydro for an intact human
spermatozoon, and the total ATP spent by one human sperm over the whole
journey, are ∅ NOT-MEASURED. The unsteady Reynolds number is not printed
at all: it is CONVENTION-DEPENDENT (flagellar radius vs flagellum length give
answers orders of magnitude apart), so CN-06 declines to print it rather than
print it wrongly. This plate declines with it.
CAPTION

1 · The regime (I) is COMPUTED on the plate, not asserted. Re = ρuL/µ with ρ = 1.0×10³ kg/m³ (water), u = 6.2×10⁻⁵ m/s (— CN06-01), L = 5.5×10⁻⁵ m (∅ CN06-06) and µ = 7.0×10⁻⁴ Pa·s (— CN06-08) gives 4.9×10⁻³ (△ CN06-10).

Every input and every product was re-evaluated for this plate and reproduces. What is load-bearing is the EXPONENT, not the digits: Re ~ 10⁻³ and d_coast ~ 10⁻¹¹ m survive any plausible revision of the inputs.

2 · The headline Re is fed by an input classed ∅ NOT-MEASURED. WHO 2021’s morphometry is NORMATIVE CRITERIA — what counts as a normal-form spermatozoon — not a measured distribution over a population (CN06-06). CN-06’s own

standing disagreement is drawn at IV: three flagellar lengths that do not reconcile, of which the only MEASURED one (41 µm) is the smallest. Carried, not averaged. Panel IV draws the measured one and names the other two.

3 · The coast (I) is △ MODELED (CN06-12) on order-of-magnitude inputs — V ≈ 17 µm³, ρ_cell ≈ 1.1×10³ kg/m³, and an effective sphere radius a ≈ 2 µm for a shape that is not a sphere. Those assumptions ARE the fence: they move the

value by factors of a few and cannot move the exponent. The bar is drawn to scale against the C–C bond, 1.54 Å. The head ellipsoid drawn at IV (4.5 × 3 µm) is that same coasting estimate’s own assumption, not a morphometric result.

4 · The axoneme (II) is drawn with NO DIMENSION because CN-06 carries none — ◇ NOT-SOURCED, a gap in OUR homework, not in the literature. The 9+2 ARRANGEMENT is sourced (CN-06 §The motor); no diameter, no spacing and no

doublet size is asserted, the cross-section is NOT TO SCALE, and the numbering and orientation are drawn for reference only. The two shaded doublets are the ○ HYPOTHESIZED active fraction (67,500 × 2/9 = 15,000 — CN06-14):
an arithmetic consequence of the two-groups-of-doublets hypothesis, NOT an observation of which doublets are active. The 67,500 total is — OBSERVED-REPLICATED by cryo-ET.

5 · The scallop theorem (III) is drawn as the REFUTED alternative ✗. The paddle’s failure is not inefficiency; it is EXACTLY ZERO. The reason is drawn in configuration space: one hinge = one degree of freedom = a cycle that must retrace

its own path and enclose no area. Purcell’s own minimal escape adds a second hinge and the cycle encloses area. This plate asserts that distinction QUALITATIVELY, as CN-06 states it, and prints NO proportionality between
enclosed area and displacement — that relation is not in the corpus.

6 · ζ⊥/ζ∥ (III) is △ MODELED with slenderness as its fence (CN06-13), and the ledger’s value is printed verbatim. ◇ PLATE NOTE, surfaced rather than patched: evaluating the row’s OWN printed formula at the row’s OWN printed range,

ln(2λ/a) ≈ 3–5, gives ≈1.43–1.64 — not the 1.5–1.8 also printed; reaching 1.8 requires ln(2λ/a) ≈ 9.5. Both readings sit INSIDE the row’s own falsifier bracket (1.4–2.0), so the row stands and is NOT refuted here; but the sub-range and

the formula do not reproduce one another. Falsifier: print the aspect ratio the 1.5–1.8 range was evaluated at. The load-bearing claim survives either reading — the ratio is of order 1.5–2, it is strictly < 2 for any real filament, and at
exactly 1 the thrust integrates to zero. The entire propulsion of every flagellate on Earth is bought from that asymmetry.

7 · The wave (IV) is drawn to scale in λ AND L ONLY, at 13.5 px per µm. AMPLITUDE AND ENVELOPE ARE ◇ NOT-SOURCED — CN-06 carries no beat amplitude — so the envelope is schematic and asserts nothing about beat shape.

c = f × λ was checked on this plate (23 × 39 = 897 ≈ 890; 11 × 18 = 198 ≈ 200 — CN06-05). Progression per beat is printed as CN-06’s table gives it; u/f on the rounded values gives 2.7 and 5.9 µm — the 0.1 µm is rounding in the
source’s inputs, not a dispute, and this plate does not manufacture one out of it.

8 · The helix (V) is drawn to scale from CN06-32 (r = 8.4 µm, pitch 47.6 µm). Those parameters are the UNSTIMULATED BASELINE: free 3-D swimming far from boundaries with NO gradient present. The gradient drawn behind the helix

renders the SAMPLING ARGUMENT that CN-06 states — the helix sweeps the flagellum through the field and a static gradient arrives as a periodic modulation — and is NOT the condition the geometry was measured under. Under a
gradient the helix is modulated; that is the whole point, and this plate prints no measured modulated geometry. The gradient’s direction is the plate’s drawing choice; CN-06 asserts none.

9 · The 33 % detour (V) is △ MODELED, computed on this plate from CN06-32’s four measured parameters: path per turn = √(pitch² + (2πr)²) = 71.1 µm buys 47.6 µm of axial progress. The same inputs give a path speed of 187 µm/s
against a measured 200 ± 57 µm/s — it sits inside the band, so geometry and kinematics, measured separately, close. Assumes a circular helix at constant pitch; that assumption is the fence.

10 · Species (VI) is a fence, not a detail: I and IV are HUMAN, II and V are SEA URCHIN, and CN-06 records the crossing as a first-class conflation trap ✗. Panels are tagged so the species cannot be lost on the way across the plate.
WHAT THIS PLATE DOES NOT CLAIM
· Not claimed: ANY axoneme dimension. CN-06 carries none. The arrangement is drawn; the metric is ◇ NOT-SOURCED and the cross-section is not to scale. Nothing on II may be measured with a ruler.

· Not claimed: that the scallop theorem governs the female reproductive tract. Cervical mucus is VISCOELASTIC ‡, the theorem’s Newtonian premise is violated there, and viscoelasticity is a NAMED ESCAPE in Lauga (2011) —

inside the theory, not a refutation of it. The theorem explains why the flagellum is a travelling wave. It forbids nothing in vivo, and this plate draws it as a constraint on DESIGN, not as a law of the oviduct.

· Not claimed: that Summers & Gibbons (1971) identified what trypsin removed. They did not. That the targets are the radial-spoke heads and nexin links, with dynein arms intact, is LATER work (Witman et al.). The ablation licenses

the conclusion — sliding is not bending; constraint is the transmission — and does NOT license reading the mechanism back into the 1971 paper. SIGNUM SIGNUM MANET: the signal and the commentary about it travel separately.

· Not claimed: that a sperm decides, wants, seeks, knows, or navigates in any sense involving experience. “EPISTEMIC ACTION” HERE IS A STATISTICAL DESCRIPTION — a policy whose selection weight includes an uncertainty-resolving
term. The helix is a sampling geometry. Nothing on this plate bears on whether anything is like anything.

· Not claimed: that human sperm perform chemotaxis. The progesterone → CatSper → Ca²⁺ physiology is replicated; whether progesterone is THE chemoattractant is disputed ‡ (CN06-33) and is carried as contested. Panel V is SEA URCHIN.

· Not claimed: that sperm sample temporally BECAUSE they are too small to read a gradient across the body. That is the folk version — ○ HYPOTHESIZED — and the measurements point elsewhere (electrotonic blurring; speed-to-size).

· Not claimed: that dynein’s ~8 nm power stroke (CN06-15) is set by the tubulin-dimer repeat. NA06-13 records the 8 nm KINESIN step as the tubulin-dimer repeat (Svoboda et al. 1993). Those are two separate rows and the corpus does
not join them. A reader will notice the coincidence; the coincidence is not an argument, and this plate does not make it one.

· Not claimed: that this vehicle is OPTIMAL, or that “nature does it this way” is an argument. Per Gould & Lewontin (1979), drift, phylogenetic inertia, developmental constraint and frozen accidents produce features that solve nothing.

Nature’s authority here is precise and limited: it already ran a very long parallel search under real physical constraints in which the failures were deleted. That makes convergence evidence of a CONSTRAINT-optimum and makes every

number on this plate a HYPOTHESIS GENERATOR — never a proof. ε_hydro ≈ 0.4–1.3 % sits in CN-06 as a standing counterexample to reading this cell as an optimised propeller, and it goes UP in high-viscosity media sea-urchin sperm

never encounter, which the authors themselves call counterintuitive. Per repo rule M7, a biomimetic design taken from this plate must beat a TUNED CONVENTIONAL BASELINE on a PRE-REGISTERED metric, with a discriminator that
collapses the gain, or it is recorded NEGATIVE.

· Not claimed: that anything here raises any UNI rung. A NATURE CITATION IS NEVER A UNI GATE. Reading Purcell 1977 does not make any UNI claim proven, designed, or built. This plate contains ZERO UNI claims, and the honest program

position is unchanged by it: ~2 of 11+ developmental rungs earned; a developmental active-inference SIMULATION; a toy world, never a person. “Full human” and “beyond human” appear nowhere as targets — they are permanent open questions.
